svg.aria-label: wireframe schematic — the app’s own layout, drawn frame by frame: the given, then each beat. given a test that tags the requirement ids it covers — qualified (asset-plan:R5) when the requirement is another screen's; beat 1: you open a requirement → its proof shows the covering test that tags it, resolved by tag — cross-screen when the tag is qualified, wherever that test's file lives
